styles.name: mandelbrot-escape
styles.description: Mandelbrot set rendered as braille: escape-time threshold rises with progress, viewport pans and zooms with time.

styles.name: julia-set
styles.description: Julia set with c=0.7885·e^(i·θ), θ animated by time; resolution and iteration depth grow with progress.

styles.name: sierpinski-triangle
styles.description: Sierpinski triangle via the chaos game (random midpoint IFS); point count grows with progress, triangle rotates with time.

styles.name: koch-curve
styles.description: Koch snowflake drawn as a dot polyline; L-system recursion depth grows with progress (0..=4), rotated and scaled by time.

styles.name: barnsley-fern
styles.description: Barnsley fern IFS (4 affine maps, exact original coefficients); point count and detail scale with progress; sways gently with time.

styles.name: dragon-curve
styles.description: Dragon curve drawn by paper-folding construction; reveal length grows with progress (up to 12 folds), rotates with time.

styles.name: sierpinski-carpet
styles.description: Sierpinski carpet: each dot is tested via the 9-ary digit rule (x&y in base 3 for any digit == 1 → hole); depth driven by progress.

styles.name: burning-ship
styles.description: Burning Ship fractal (z → (|Re z|+i|Im z|)² + c); its jagged, ship-like silhouette burns across the bar as progress rises.

styles.name: pythagoras-tree
styles.description: Pythagoras tree: a square sprouts two smaller squares at a time-animated split angle; branch count grows with progress (depth 0..=7).

styles.name: newton-fractal
styles.description: Newton fractal for z³−1=0: three root basins painted with palette colors; iteration count threshold rises with progress, domain rotates with time.

styles.name: cantor-dust
styles.description: Cantor dust: 2-D middle-third removal across rows; each row is a deeper level of the Cantor set, revealing from top to bottom with progress.

styles.name: lyapunov-bar
styles.description: Lyapunov exponent landscape for the logistic map sequence AABB…; each column is a parameter r swept across [2.5, 4.0], lit where the exponent is negative (stable). Progress raises the iteration count; time scrolls the AB sequence phase.
